Class Book

java.lang.Object
library.model.Book
public class Book extends Object
Represents a book in the library system. Each book has a unique ID, title, author, category, status, and optionally tracks who it is issued to and its due date.
Author:
Usman

  • Constructor Details

    • Book

      public Book(String id, String title, String author, Category category)
      Constructs a new Book with the specified details. Status defaults to AVAILABLE.
      Parameters:
      id - the unique book ID
      title - the title of the book
      author - the author of the book
      category - the category of the book

    • Book

      public Book(String id, String title, String author, Category category, BookStatus status, String issuedTo, String dueDate, String reservedBy)
      Constructs a Book with all fields specified (used for loading from storage).
      Parameters:
      id - the unique book ID
      title - the title of the book
      author - the author of the book
      category - the category of the book
      status - the current status
      issuedTo - the member ID the book is issued to
      dueDate - the due date string
      reservedBy - the member ID who reserved the book
